name: Northeast Group Berhad
overview: Northeast Group Berhad 今年提出收购位于 Pulau Pinang 的两块租赁土地及一座仓库，用于扩大精密工程业务的产能；同时调整 IPO 募集资金用途并延长时间框架。公司未公告新增或退出业务线。
overview_en: Northeast Group Berhad this year proposed to acquire two leasehold land parcels and a warehouse in Pulau Pinang to expand capacity for its precision engineering business, while varying the use of IPO proceeds and extending the timeframe. No new business lines were announced or exited.

segments.name: 精密工程服务
segments.note: 公司提出收购 Pulau Pinang 的两块租赁土地及一座仓库，用于扩大精密工程业务的产能。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to acquire two leasehold land parcels and a warehouse in Pulau Pinang to expand capacity for its precision engineering business.

actions.title: i) Proposed Acquisitions ii) Proposed Variation
actions.text: 拟以现金 RM5,553,640 收购位于 Pulau Pinang Seberang Perai Tengah 的一块租赁土地（PM 340, Lot 519, Mukim 13）。
actions.text_en: Proposed cash acquisition of a leasehold land (PM 340, Lot 519, Mukim 13) in Seberang Perai Tengah, Pulau Pinang for RM5,553,640.

actions.title: i) Proposed Acquisitions ii) Proposed Variation
actions.text: 拟以现金 RM10,800,000 收购位于 Pulau Pinang Seberang Perai Tengah 的另一块租赁土地（PM 461, Lot 20823, Mukim 13）及地上仓库。
actions.text_en: Proposed cash acquisition of another leasehold land (PM 461, Lot 20823, Mukim 13) together with a warehouse in Seberang Perai Tengah, Pulau Pinang for RM10,800,000.
